metadata.description:
The high-stakes campaign for the Jharkhand Assembly elections concluded today, with 38 seats up for grabs in this phase. All eyes are on the Santhal Pargana region, a traditional Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) bastion. In the previous assembly elections, JMM had dominated this tribal heartland, securing the majority of its seats here. This time, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has intensified its efforts to make inroads, focusing on issues like alleged Bangladeshi infiltration. However, the BJP's campaign has gained limited traction among voters in this region.
Ground reports suggest that the JMM remains strong in Santhal Pargana, benefiting from its grassroots connections and tribal-centric policies. The electorate here resonates more with JMM's developmental narrative than the BJP's polarizing issues. With the phase now over, all eyes are on the voting day, which will determine if JMM retains its stronghold or faces surprises.
